profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead a cross-platform team building the ESPN Android TV, Fire TV, Portal TV, and tvOS applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a variety of Android applications across the Disney portfolio including the ESPN mobile/OTT applications and the National Geographic application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of ESPN's OTT application development team leading the development of ESPN's OTT Android applications.

Led the development of a variety of Android applications: the ESPN Fire TV and Android TV apps, the WatchESPN video integration into the ESPN Android mobile app, and the ESPN Cricket Pass app.

Also worked on multiple backend Spring Boot services: a GraphQL API and a content aggregation service used by the mobile and OTT ESPN apps.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed networking components in C++ for software-defined radios running on an embedded system.

Developed SELinux policy and C++ applications for multiple programs. Also, built multiple SELinux front end development tools using Python and PyGTK.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Intern for the Advanced Technology Lab designing and building a PXE server for the rapid installment of multiple operating systems on numerous platforms.

positions.title: Computer Engineer Intern
positions.description: Analyzed manufacturing & procurement process of high-voltage transformers to provide ways of improving and updating that process
